term.value: Lease 8/11/1997; commenced 11/19/1998. Original 10-year term, extended by the Third Amendment (2013) and then the Fourth Amendment (6/28/2023), which extends the Initial Term to 2/28/2034 (Extension Term commencing 12/1/2023). Two 5-year renewal options remain, exercisable on ≥6 months' notice, running to 2/29/2044.

optionNotes: Two 5-year renewal options (Fourth Amendment), each on ≥6 months' notice. Rent: First Option (3/1/2034–2/28/2039) $33.28/SF ($324,280.32); Second Option (3/1/2039–2/29/2044) $36.60/SF ($356,630.40).

percentageRent.value: 2% of Sales above a natural breakpoint. The 'Sales Base' (breakpoint) = the fixed minimum rent for the calendar year ÷ 2% (so it floats up with each rent step). Prorated for partial calendar years.

cite.section: Basic Lease Provisions (Percentage Rent Rate / Sales Base); §4.4

exclusives.description: COSMETICS exclusive (Lease §7.10): no other premises in the Shopping Center (except Ulta's own premises, 'Retail F', and the 2,470 SF Bath Works space in 'Retail G' and its successors) may have a PRIMARY business of selling cosmetics, fragrances or hair-care products. Incidental sales by other stores are allowed, and beauty-salon operations are not prohibited. Runs with the land.

coTenancy.value: OPENING co-tenancy only — now expired/moot. The base lease conditioned Ulta's rent concession on the four 'Inducement Tenants' (King Soopers, Homeplace, OfficeMax, Just For Feet) opening by 12/1/1997 (free rent per day until they opened). There is NO ongoing co-tenancy giving Ulta a mid-term rent reduction or termination right today. (Fourth Amendment §7 references 'co-tenancy failure' generically only as a preserved category of claim, not an active ongoing co-tenancy.)

camTax.value: CAM (§12.2): pro-rata Common Area Charges; EXCLUDES capital improvements (capital repairs/replacements allowed only amortized over useful life, no interest), environmental testing/abatement, and administrative/clerical/management personnel and reserve-fund contributions; admin/management fee CAPPED at 10% of CAM. Initial estimate $1.25/SF. Real Estate Taxes: pro-rata (initial $1.75/SF), Tenant contest rights. Insurance: pro-rata of Landlord's CGL + property/fire premiums (initial $0.19/SF). All reconciled within 60 days after year-end.

leaseNotes.label: Exclusive Use
leaseNotes.value: Cosmetics/fragrance/hair-care exclusive (primary-business test), carve-outs for Retail F and the 2,470 SF Bath Works space in Retail G; incidental sales and beauty salons permitted. Runs with the land.

leaseNotes.label: Co-tenancy
leaseNotes.value: OPENING co-tenancy only (Inducement Tenants — King Soopers, Homeplace, OfficeMax, Just For Feet — free rent until they opened by 12/1/1997); EXPIRED. No ongoing co-tenancy / no mid-term rent-reduction or termination right tied to anchor occupancy.

leaseNotes.label: Kickout/Termination (LL)
leaseNotes.value: Landlord go-dark recapture (§7.1.1, 30-day cessation → 30-day termination); plus casualty/condemnation rights.

leaseNotes.label: Kickout/Termination (Tenant)
leaseNotes.value: Tenant may terminate on certain eminent-domain takings — e.g. loss of ≥10% of the parking within a 150-ft radius of the entrance, or parking falling below a 2.4:1 ratio (§9.2); plus casualty rights. (No ongoing co-tenancy termination right.)

leaseNotes.label: LL Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: Landlord bound by Ulta's cosmetics exclusive (§7.10) and the Center's Restricted Uses (Exhibit E) / Noxious Uses (Exhibit E-1); Landlord covenants Tenant's permitted retail use won't be restricted by other Center agreements (§7.4).

leaseNotes.label: Tenant Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: Subject to the Center's Restricted Uses / Noxious Uses and other tenants' exclusives.

leaseNotes.label: CAM Method
leaseNotes.value: Pro-rata Common Area Charges; admin/management fee CAPPED at 10%; EXCLUDES capital improvements (capital repairs amortized over useful life only), environmental costs, management/clerical personnel and reserves. Initial estimate $1.25/SF. 60-day year-end reconciliation; Tenant verification right.

leaseNotes.label: Tax Method
leaseNotes.value: Pro-rata Real Property Taxes (initial estimate $1.75/SF); Tenant right to contest.

leaseNotes.label: Insurance Method
leaseNotes.value: Pro-rata share of Landlord's common-area CGL and building fire/extended-coverage (incl. rent-loss) premiums; initial estimate $0.19/SF.

leaseNotes.label: Assignment & Sublet
leaseNotes.value: Per the Fourth Amendment §6: Ulta may assign WITHOUT Landlord consent for collateral purposes, merger, transfer to a parent/subsidiary/affiliate, stock sale, consolidation, or sale of substantially all assets (if the surviving entity maintains Ulta's tangible net worth); OR a sale of ≥10 Ulta stores to a single entity with ≥$50M net worth (CPI-adjusted); plus concessions/subleases that blend into one operating unit.

leaseNotes.label: Alterations
leaseNotes.value: Per Original Lease §7.6 (alterations) and §7.7 (mechanics' liens). The Fourth Amendment contemplates a Tenant Renovation (interior/non-structural + exterior signage/paint) with a Landlord allowance (see below).

leaseNotes.label: Operating Covenant
leaseNotes.value: Duty to open fully stocked as an 'Ulta3 Cosmetics & Salon' store at commencement (min. one day); no continuous-operation covenant beyond that — BUT see Go Dark (a 30-day cessation triggers a Landlord recapture).

leaseNotes.label: Go Dark Option
leaseNotes.value: LANDLORD RECAPTURE LEVER: if Tenant ceases operations for 30 or more days in any 12-month period (excluding holidays and force-majeure/casualty), Landlord may TERMINATE the Lease on 30 days' written notice (§7.1.1). This is a relatively tight go-dark trigger — worth monitoring if Ulta ever closes for a remodel beyond 30 days (though the Fourth Amendment permits partial closure for its renovation).

leaseNotes.label: Default
leaseNotes.value: Tenant monetary default (§13.1(a)): 10 days after written notice. Non-monetary defaults per §13.1 (notice + cure). Landlord remedies per Art. 13.

leaseNotes.label: Guaranty
leaseNotes.value: None — Ulta Salon, Cosmetics & Fragrance, Inc. is the tenant.

leaseNotes.label: Outparcel Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: Center governed by recorded restrictions / REAs; monument signs on Colorado Blvd and East Yale Ave.

leaseNotes.label: Purchase Option / ROFR
leaseNotes.value: None noted.

leaseNotes.label: Holdover
leaseNotes.value: Holdover = liquidated damages of 2× the rent (prorated daily); no year-to-year tenancy created (§14.6).

leaseNotes.label: Relocation
leaseNotes.value: None noted.

leaseNotes.label: Utilities
leaseNotes.value: Per base lease (separately metered / tenant-paid).

leaseNotes.label: HVAC / Maintenance
leaseNotes.value: Per base lease; Tenant maintains its premises/HVAC, Landlord the common areas/structure.

leaseNotes.label: Pylon / Signage
leaseNotes.value: Exclusive signage rights on the Premises' exterior/interior (§7.9); first right to an available monument-sign panel on Colorado Blvd / East Yale Ave (behind King Soopers, OfficeMax, Homeplace and any larger tenant).

leaseNotes.label: Subordination / SNDA
leaseNotes.value: Tenant subordinates only with a Non-Disturbance Agreement (Exhibit F form) from any existing/future mortgagee recognizing the lease so long as Tenant isn't in default. Per Fourth Amendment §9, Landlord represented (June 2023) NO mortgage/ground lease encumbered the Center.

leaseNotes.label: Estoppel
leaseNotes.value: Per base lease general provisions.

flags.issue: Mid-term lever: Landlord go-dark RECAPTURE on a 30-day closure
flags.detail: Ulta's tightest mid-term exposure is a LANDLORD lever, not a tenant one: if Ulta ceases operating for 30+ days in any 12-month period (ex-holidays/force majeure), Landlord may terminate on 30 days' notice (§7.1.1). Relevant if Ulta closes for an extended remodel (the Fourth Amendment does permit partial closure for its renovation). Ulta has NO ongoing co-tenancy out and no sales/kickout termination. Tenant termination is limited to eminent-domain/casualty.

narrative: Ulta Beauty (Ulta Salon, Cosmetics & Fragrance, Inc.; store #70) occupies 9,744 SF (Suite 30) at University Hills, Denver under a 8/11/1997 lease that commenced 11/19/1998. The controlling document is the 6/28/2023 Fourth Amendment, which extends the term to 2/28/2034 at $27.50/SF stepping to $30.25/SF, with two 5-year options at $33.28 and $36.60/SF running to 2/29/2044 — all matching the April-2026 rent roll. Ulta pays 2% percentage rent over a natural breakpoint, holds a cosmetics/fragrance/hair-care exclusive (carve-outs for Retail F and the small Bath Works space), and has broad assignment rights (collateral/merger/affiliate transfers and ≥10-store portfolio sales to a $50M-net-worth buyer, no consent). The Fourth Amendment also grants Ulta a $270,000 renovation allowance if it remodels by 10/1/2026 — a KPR landlord obligation to track. No tenant guaranty. The full 17-document folder was enumerated; the controlling economics and key business terms are source-verified, with some qualitative base-lease clauses left for a deeper pass to conserve bandwidth.
